title: Effect of a compiled arithmetic instruction
statement: For an arithmetic operation $o$ and word-RAM memory $m$, if the values in cells $j$ and $k$ are the $W$-bit encodings of integers $a$ and $b$, respectively, then executing the instruction representing $o$ with destination cell $i$ changes the memory exactly by writing the $W$-bit encoding of $o(a,b)$ to cell $i$.
hypotheses_covered: The source cell j contains the W-bit encoding of a
The source cell k contains the W-bit encoding of b
